tools.name: roll_random_birth
tools.description: Draw a random human birth weighted by how many people were actually born in each place and century/decade between 1 CE and 2025 (or within a chosen year), returning the birthplace, odds, life expectancy, historical events during that lifetime, and a playable BornThen link for those five lives.

tools.name: query_era_facts
tools.description: Look up BornThen demographic figures (population, life expectancy, child mortality, literacy, urbanisation, each labelled statistic / estimate / model) and sourced historical events (wars, famines, plagues, depressions) by year, period slug (e.g. "1920s", "14th-century"), place, or event keyword.
